name: Seijuu Ane to Junjou Kanojo ga H ni Ore Soudatsu Sen
original_name: 性獣姉と純情彼女がHに俺争奪戦
source:
The protagonist confesses his feelings to his childhood friend, a hot-headed blonde, and gets a positive response, leading to his first sexual encounter with her!
It's all smooth sailing! Feeling unstoppable, the protagonist rushes into his house and begs his strong-willed, black-haired sister, who treats him like a sex toy, to end their relationship, but she ends up straddling him right there!
He thinks he has to somehow end his relationship with his sister, but he just can't seem to win against her.
Then his childhood friend, ready to fight, barges into his house! And of course, his sister fights back!
As they physically struggle, things slowly take an erotic turn...
What will be the fate of the protagonist caught between the two?

[From [url=https://gyutto.com/i/item98299?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
translation:
主角向他儿时的朋友、一个头脑发热的金发女郎表白了自己的感情，并得到了积极的回应，导致了他与她的第一次性接触！
一切都很顺利！主角感到势不可挡，冲进家中，恳求意志坚强、视他为性玩具的黑发妹妹结束他们的关系，但她最终跨坐在他身上！
他认为他必须以某种方式结束与妹妹的关系，但他似乎无法战胜她。
然后他儿时的朋友做好了战斗的准备，闯进了他的房子！当然，他的妹妹也会反击！
当他们的身体挣扎时，事情慢慢发生了色情转变……
夹在两人之间的主角的命运又会如何呢？
